description: Which commodities are recorded in USGS MRDS inside an area, with a site count per commodity — the "what is this region mined for" tool. Also serves as the lookup for the commodity symbols that mrdata_search_deposits expects. Sourced from USGS MRData.

bbox.description: Bounding box "minLon,minLat,maxLon,maxLat" (WGS84). Omit to get the symbol reference list with no counts.

sample_size.description: How many sites in the box to tally (default 500, max 2000)

name: mrdata_commodities
title: Mrdata Commodities
